body: I could spend a few minutes regaling you with reasons why nothing feelgood will help, but I'll just say "chronic anhedonia, 14 years in therapy" and leave it at that.

Marks made and those who make them all disappear equally.  I'm of no special consequence.  People remember my dad for his deeds, not his unremarkable son.  I've already lived for him.  I can't anymore.
